NextNumber.Name: Next session number
NextNumber.Hint: The number the next session gets. Goes up by one every time a session ends. Set it to continue your campaign's numbering.

AutoStart.Name: Start recording
AutoStart.Hint: What happens when the GM logs in and no session is being recorded.
AutoStart.Never: Only from the Session Summary window

AutoExport.Name: Export when the session ends
AutoExport.Hint: Write the summary files into the Data folder as soon as the GM ends the session.

Folder.Name: Export folder
Folder.Hint: Folder inside Foundry's Data folder for the summary files. A bot on the same computer reads them from here (e.g. %LOCALAPPDATA%/FoundryVTT/Data/session-summaries).

Notify.NotActiveGM: Only the active GM ({name}) records and changes the session.
Notify.ExportFailed: Could not write the session summary: {error}

Start.Title: Start recording?
Start.Content: Start recording session {n}? Kills, dice, scenes and movement are counted until you end the session.

End.Title: End session
End.Content: End session {n}? Recording stops and the summary is written for your bot.

Discard.Title: Discard session
Discard.Content: Throw away everything recorded in this session? Files that were already exported stay.

Stale.Title: Session still open
Stale.Content: Session {n} was never ended (last activity {since}). Is this a new session?
Stale.EndNew: End it, start a new one

Window.NotActiveGM: Read only: the session is recorded by the active GM,
Window.Title: Title
Window.Notes: GM notes (shown at the end of the Discord text)
Window.DiceHint: Player rolls only. Per die: max results / 1s. Only the kept die of advantage and disadvantage counts.
Window.Guessed: No attack or damage card named the attacker: credited to whoever's turn it was.
Window.NoSessionHint: Recording runs on the active GM's client. Players don't need to do anything.
Window.AchievementsHint: Everyone gets one. Shown for the session so far; it can still change until the session ends.

blessed.Title: Session's Blessed
blessed.Desc: Rolled the most natural 20s in the party.

unluckiest.Title: Session's Unluckiest
unluckiest.Desc: Rolled the most natural 1s in the party.

giantSlayer.Title: Giant Slayer
giantSlayer.Desc: Landed the killing blow on the toughest enemy of the session (the highest challenge rating).

executioner.Title: Executioner
executioner.Desc: Landed the most killing blows: the hit that drops an enemy to 0 HP.

medic.Title: Field Medic
medic.Desc: Healed the most HP in the party, temporary HP included.

heavyHitter.Title: Heavy Hitter
heavyHitter.Desc: Rolled the biggest single damage roll of the session.

meatShield.Title: Meat Shield
meatShield.Desc: Took the most damage in the party.

floorInspector.Title: Floor Inspector
floorInspector.Desc: Dropped to 0 HP more often than anyone else.

friendlyFire.Title: Friendly Fire
friendlyFire.Desc: Dealt the most damage to their own allies. Oops.

wreckingBall.Title: Wrecking Ball
wreckingBall.Desc: Dealt the most damage to enemies.

sharpshooter.Title: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.Desc: Had the best hit rate in the party (at least 4 attacks against a known AC).

stormtrooper.Title: Stormtrooper
stormtrooper.Desc: Missed more attacks than anyone else.

hotDice.Title: Hot Dice
hotDice.Desc: Had the highest average on d20 rolls (at least 5 rolls).

coldDice.Title: Cold Dice
coldDice.Desc: Had the lowest average on d20 rolls (at least 5 rolls).

maxPower.Title: Max Power
maxPower.Desc: Rolled the most dice that landed on their highest number (a 6 on a d6, an 8 on a d8, …).

snakeEyes.Title: Snake Eyes
snakeEyes.Desc: Rolled the most dice that landed on 1, on any kind of die.

wanderer.Title: Wanderer
wanderer.Desc: Walked the furthest across the maps.

diceGoblin.Title: Dice Goblin
diceGoblin.Desc: Made the most rolls in the party.

homebody.Title: Homebody
homebody.Desc: Walked the least while the others roamed the maps.

deathDefier.Title: Death Defier
deathDefier.Desc: Rolled a natural 20 on a death saving throw and got back on their feet.

beastmaster.Title: Beastmaster
beastmaster.Desc: Their summon or companion landed a killing blow.

firstBlood.Title: First Blood
firstBlood.Desc: Landed the first killing blow of the session.

closer.Title: The Closer
closer.Desc: Landed the last killing blow of the session.

butterfingers.Title: Butterfingers
butterfingers.Desc: Rolled a natural 1 on an attack roll.

untouchable.Title: Untouchable
untouchable.TextOne: no damage taken in the fight
untouchable.Desc: Didn't take a single point of damage, even though there were fights.

pacifist.Title: Pacifist
pacifist.Desc: Took part but didn't deal any damage, even though there were fights.

perfectlyAverage.Title: Perfectly Average
perfectlyAverage.Desc: Their d20 average landed right around 10.5, the exact middle of the die.

quietOne.Title: The Quiet One
quietOne.Desc: Rolled the dice five times or fewer all session.

teamPlayer.Title: Team Player
teamPlayer.Desc: No records broken this time, but always there for the party.

sightseer.Title: Sightseer
sightseer.Desc: No records broken this time, but took in every place the party visited.

steadfast.Title: Steadfast
steadfast.Desc: No records broken this time, but held their ground with the party.

moralSupport.Title: Moral Support
moralSupport.Desc: No records broken this time, but kept the party's spirits up.

mainCharacter.Title: Main Character
mainCharacter.Desc: No records broken this time, but every story needs one.

snackKeeper.Title: Keeper of Snacks
snackKeeper.Desc: No records broken this time, but someone has to keep the party fed.

alongForTheRide.Title: Along for the Ride
alongForTheRide.Desc: No records broken this time, but along for every step of the adventure.
